posts.title: Headset bearings, and when to stop caring
posts.excerpt: A loose headset announces itself. A tight one just wears out quietly.
posts.body: Sealed cartridges changed the maths. Grease still wins on a winter bike, and a cup-and-cone headset you can service in the stand will outlast three sealed ones you cannot.

posts.title: Truing a wheel in eleven minutes
posts.excerpt: Not because speed matters, but because a slow true is usually an indecisive one.
posts.body: Work opposite pairs. Chase the wobble, not the spoke. If the rim will not come round in three passes, the problem is tension, not alignment.

posts.title: The winter drivetrain argument
posts.excerpt: Wax, oil, or neglect: an honest accounting of all three.
posts.body: Wax is cleaner and slower to apply. Oil is faster and dirtier. Neglect is free until February, when it is not.
